scope.topic: consumer chat subscription allowance policies and public/live/crowdsourced tracking
excluded_surfaces: coding-only Vibe/Grok Build use as chat evidence
scope.codex_quota_source_rule: Any OpenAI Codex quota value may use only the TiboTattle homepage; this package reports no Codex allowance number.
scope.user_report_tier_rule: Record the exact tier stated by each report author; otherwise use not stated; never infer from price, thread title, another commenter, or image alt text.

browser: Codex built-in web__run search/open/find only; no Edge/Chrome/CUA used for this extension.

followup_search_attempt.initial_cua_status: built-in iab unavailable; proposed queries in query_log.md were not executed during that attempt
followup_search_attempt.subsequent_search_route: Codex built-in web research; no external browser used
followup_search_attempt.result_summary: Added 11 current-window Reddit/Hacker News allowance discussions; no reproducible normalized cross-account allowance estimate was supported.
followup_search_attempt.note: The initial CUA limitation is retained for audit. The primary agent later executed a separate expanded query set through the built-in web research route.

silver_bullet.note: Session-local repository alias was registered after the agent session began without it; references then read successfully. Do not describe general workflow unavailability.

deep_research_skill.limitation: Silver Bullet runtime command was not invoked; phase contract applied manually and artifacts recorded.

cutoff_rules.community_reports_before_cutoff: discovery_only; cannot support current allowance estimates
cutoff_rules.mixed_windows: excluded unless a post-cutoff segment is separately identified
cutoff_rules.official_policy: reported separately as provider policy context, not measurement

coverage.numeric_account_claims: Several unverified user claims are retained as qualitative account reports; they are not transferable plan allowances.
coverage.coverage_boundary: Bounded public web search; not exhaustive of private, deleted, login-gated, unindexed, or regional sources.

schemas.sources.jsonl: One source per line; source_id, title, url, publisher, source_type, access_status, dates, eligibility, notes.
schemas.evidence.jsonl: One evidence item per line; evidence_id, source_id, evidence_type, dates/interval, plan/model/action, method, locator, paraphrase, use, confidence.
schemas.claims.jsonl: One atomic claim per line; claim_id, claim, type, status, evidence_ids, scope, qualifier.

question: Identify consumer AI chat allowance meters and apps; distinguish provider meters, local estimates, API spend, and crowd reports.

search_cli.fallback_reason: User required Codex built-in web__run only for search/open/find.

tool_routing_notes: An initial ctx_execute JavaScript attempt returned unsupported language; data validation then used the supported Python route.
No result from the failed JavaScript tool call was used as evidence.
The initial CUA browser attempt remains separately marked unexecuted in query_log.md.

validation.citation_validator: pass_with_8_http_probe_exceptions (25/33 URL probes accessible; 0 suspicious; source pages separately opened or indexed during research)

validation_details.claim_support: The SB validator expects text/quote fields. The two needs_review rows are pre-cutoff/out-of-scope examples, not current consumer-chat allowance conclusions.

registry_validation.date_gate_note: Eligibility counts use source publication dates; provider-policy pages and update/check timestamps remain separate.
